/-- Notation type class for the set product `×ˢ`. -/
class SProd (α : Type u) (β : Type v) (γ : outParam (Type w)) where
  /-- The Cartesian product `s ×ˢ t` is the set of `(a, b)` such that `a ∈ s` and `b ∈ t`. -/
  sprod : α → β → γ
